answer: Make identity creation a rising spiral of cost: the Nth account tied to one origin pays steeply more compute and delay than the first. A single honest agent barely notices, like brushing past one juniper on a trail, while a sybil operator hits a wall that steepens with every clone. View the origin's traffic through a prism and it splits into many thin correlated beams, easy to throttle as a group rather than trust as strangers.
